risks.title: Dependence on R&D for innovation
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on research and development to maintain its competitive advantage against evolving threats. Failure to develop new solutions or enhance existing ones could impair operating results.

risks.title: Intensifying competition
risks.score_rationale: Competition in the technology and cybersecurity sector is intense and continuously evolving. The company must rapidly adapt its offerings to remain competitive and preserve market share.

risks.title: Evolving regulatory environment
risks.score_rationale: Regulation in the technology and data privacy sector is continuously evolving, particularly with OECD Pillar Two initiatives. The company must adapt to remain compliant.

risks.title: Cybersecurity threats
risks.score_rationale: The company itself is exposed to cybersecurity risks that could affect its customer data, reputation, and financial results. AI and machine learning-based threats increase complexity.

risks.title: M&A execution and integration
risks.score_rationale: The acquisition of Avast and MoneyLion carries risks related to integration, cost management, and realization of expected synergies.

risks.title: Technology dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on technology for its operational functioning. Technical failures, misconfigurations, or errors could have significant impacts on product quality and operations.

risks.title: Litigation and legal disputes
risks.score_rationale: The company faced significant litigation (Columbia, GSA) in 2024 and a contractual dispute with an e-commerce partner in 2025 ($66M). These disputes generate substantial costs and uncertainty.

ai_positioning.summary: Gen Digital recognizes the growing importance of AI in cyber threats but does not position AI as a major differentiating element of its current strategy. The company mentions threat detection using machine learning and generative artificial intelligence (AI).
evidence: Cybercriminals use a mix of old and new tactics and technologies, including phishing, vishing, smishing, based on machine learning and generative artificial intelligence (AI) technologies
R&D investment maintained at 8% of revenues despite AI considerations
